basic_info.description: Welcome to 1371 Revere Ave, a remarkable duplex located in the vibrant Bayview neighborhood. This property offers a combined 2,550 sqft of living space, perfect for investors or those seeking a spacious home with rental potential. The top unit features 2 bedrooms plus 2 additional rooms, offering a spacious and bright layout. The lower unit includes 2 bedrooms plus 1 additional room, designed for cozy and functional living. Both units are delivered vacant, providing a blank canvas for your personal touch or immediate rental opportunities. Key features include proximity to Chase Center, Mission Bay, UCSF Mission Bay, hiking trails, Martin Luther King Jr. Park, and a community swimming pool. The property also offers convenient transportation options with the T line and freeway access. Ideally situated for enjoying all that San Francisco has to offer, from world-class entertainment and dining to outdoor activities and top-tier medical facilities, this property is a unique opportunity to own a versatile home in one of the city's most dynamic areas. Don't miss out on this exceptional listing!
